proof_body:
by
  intro V _ G h
  have hadj : ∀ a b : V, ¬ G.Reachable a b → Gᶜ.Adj a b := by
    intro a b hab
    rw [SimpleGraph.compl_adj]
    exact ⟨fun e => hab (e ▸ SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl a), fun e => hab e.reachable⟩
  have hp : Gᶜ.Preconnected := by
    intro u v
    by_cases huv : G.Reachable u v
    · simp only [SimpleGraph.Preconnected, not_forall] at h
      obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := h
      by_cases hua : G.Reachable u a
      · have hub : ¬ G.Reachable u b := fun hub => hab (hua.symm.trans hub)
        have hvb : ¬ G.Reachable v b := fun hvb => hub (huv.trans hvb)
        exact (hadj u b hub).reachable.trans (hadj v b hvb).reachable.symm
      · have hva : ¬ G.Reachable v a := fun hva => hua (huv.trans hva)
        exact (hadj u a hua).reachable.trans (hadj v a hva).reachable.symm
    · exact (hadj u v huv).reachable
  exact ⟨hp⟩
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [Nonempty V] (G : SimpleGraph V), ¬ G.Preconnected → Gᶜ.Connected
